title: Web Modernization
html: NIH has launched its new website experience with the beta version of NIH.gov and the new thematic hubs. This modernized web environment is designed to make it easier to find health information, research, funding opportunities, and other resources. NIH's existing websites will remain available during the transition with redirects and notices guiding you to the new environment. Review the Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) below for more information.
